description: Lends to borrowers banks turn down: personal loans, auto finance, credit cards.
reasons: Net income fell 33% quarter over quarter while receivables still grew, so growth is being bought with looser credit.
Provisions rose 31% quarter over quarter and EPS fell year over year, 1.45 to 1.31, while estimates tilted lower at 6 up against 8 down over 30 days.
8.6x earnings only looks cheap if credit holds; provisions rising 31% a quarter would cut earnings and force a re-rating lower.

quants.eps_revisions: tilted lower, with 6 up and 8 down over 30 days
extra: Last reported quarter: net income -33% quarter over quarter, provisions +31%
Q2 EPS declined year over year, 1.45 -> 1.31
Counterpoint in the tape: management reports early-stage delinquencies improving, so the thesis needs the next two prints

structuring.thesis_target: Targeting the late-January report allows two quarters for the credit story to play out.
structuring.reflection: Credit is 14.8% mid but exactly 10.0% if priced against me, so the floor only holds at eight shorts; the seven the ladder suggests first would be 8.8%.
